research_question: Does the frozen Stage 17B direct-customer HGB pipeline retain strong discrimination on the held-out CONFIRMATION population?

stage14_frozen_comparator.authorized_scope: Optional frozen ranking comparator only; no retraining or tuning. Its historical model/threshold selection used the original validation population, now CONFIRMATION, so threshold metrics are explicitly optimistic and it cannot affect the primary gate.

success_interpretation_frozen_before_sco.A_STRONG_CONFIRMATION: Confirmation ROC-AUC >= 0.75 and AP >= 0.30, with the separate customer-bootstrap 95% lower bounds >= 0.70 for ROC-AUC and >= 0.20 for AP.
success_interpretation_frozen_before_sco.B_PARTIAL_OR_DEGRADED_CONFIRMATION: Decision A is not met, but ROC-AUC >= 0.65 and AP >= max(0.15, 1.5 times confirmation theft prevalence).
success_interpretation_frozen_before_sco.C_CONFIRMATION_FAILURE: Decision B minimum discrimination is not met.

uncertainty_policy.confirmation_bootstrap: 2,000 customer resamples, seed 42, percentile 95% intervals for ROC-AUC and AP
uncertainty_policy.development_confirmation_difference: 2,000 independent two-sample customer bootstraps, seed 42, CONFIRMATION minus DEV_VAL; datasets are never pooled
uncertainty_policy.stage14_comparator: 2,000 paired CONFIRMATION-customer resamples, seed 42, frozen Stage17B direct HGB minus frozen Stage14 window-to-customer HGB

data_access_policy.confirmation: One evaluation of the frozen Stage17B pipeline is authorized after this audit is written.
data_access_policy.final_test: CLOSED. Features, labels, predictions, and performance must not be loaded or evaluated.
